summary: A drop zone for files, in three shapes, dashed or solid, that picks by click or by drop and lists what it holds.

props.name: browseLabel
props.description: The link in the line under the title that opens the file picker.

props.name: hint
props.description: The rest of that line, after the link, for what this zone accepts.

props.name: items
props.description: Files your app is uploading, each with its own progress, listed under the zone in place of the picked ones. Pair with `onCancel`.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called with an item's `id` when its cancel button is pressed.

props.name: description
props.description: A line outside the zone, for formats and limits. Replaced by `error`'s message when it is set.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the cloud glyph in the tile. It is sized and colored by the zone, so pass the glyph and nothing else.

props.name: accept
props.description: Passed to the file input, so the picker filters by it. A comma separated list of extensions or MIME types, `image/*,.pdf`. A drop is not filtered: the browser only applies this to the picker, so check the type yourself in `onFilesChange`.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Lets the zone hold more than one file. Each pick or drop adds to the list, and a file already in it is not added twice; off, the newest file replaces the old one.

props.name: onFilesChange
props.description: Called with the whole list whenever it changes, on a pick, a drop or a removal.

props.name: border
props.description: `dashed` is the drop-zone convention and carries the extra width it needs to read as one. `solid` is a heavier, more permanent box, so it stays thin. `none` leaves the zone to its background.

props.name: error
props.description: Turns the border, tile and text red & shows this message in place of `description`. Crosses with `border`, so a solid zone can be in error too.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks the picker and refuses drops, dims the zone and fills it, so it reads as unavailable rather than merely empty.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
